description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Si/NMC pouch cell (10% Si blend anode)
cell.source: Zheng et al. (2014), J. Electrochem. Soc. 161(11), A2066; McDowell et al. (2013), Adv. Mater. 25, 4966

capacity_ref.note: Nominal capacity at T_ref (higher than pure graphite due to Si capacity contribution)

R_ref.note: Internal resistance at T_ref (298.15 K); slightly lower than pure graphite due to Si SEI differences

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Fitted to Si/NMC OCV data; NMC cathode dominates the OCV shape, slightly offset from pure NMC due to Si anode plateau at ~0.4V vs Li

E_a.note: Activation energy for internal resistance; higher than NMC due to Si-induced SEI layer cracking increasing effective Ea
E_a.source: Plett (2015), Battery Management Systems Vol. 2, Artech House; Lundqvist et al. (2021), J. Electrochem. Soc. 168, 060522

alpha_c.note: Linear capacity temperature coefficient (same order as NMC)
alpha_c.source: Schmalstieg et al. (2014), J. Power Sources 257, 325

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient; Si-blend anode shifts dOCV/dT slightly less negative than pure graphite/NMC; avg -0.15 mV/K over SOC range
dOCV_dT.source: Geng et al. (2020), J. Electrochem. Soc. 167, 090504; Thomas & Newman (2003), J. Electrochem. Soc. 150, A176
